title: Mixed Event — Singing in Sync — Episode1 STAY GOLD

meta.Event Outline: As Vivid BAD SQUAD takes its first steps, An and Kohane are both fully confident that they have the best partner in one another. However, the two partners quickly find themselves hitting a snag. Will they be able to get through it?!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright! Now that we're all here, let's talk about our plans for the future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You wanted to discuss what kinds of events Vivid BAD SQUAD should be in next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it's like we're a real team now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do you mean like a real team?
We ARE a real team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, we need to decide what sorts of events to gear up for as a group from now on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, the BAD DOGS and Vivids have completely different styles so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should find something that's a good fit for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been thinking about what would be good for us, but there are just so many choices.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Are there that many different types of events?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You've only done invitational ones before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The events that are held around here broadly fall into one of two categories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, you have invitation-based ones, where a venue asks certain artists to perform.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what we did as the Vivids.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a little overwhelming at first, but everyone was so friendly that I forgot about being anxious really quickly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, those events are organized among friends, so they're pretty laidback. The other event category is battles.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
B-Battles?!
You fight each other?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha, kind of but it's pretty standard.
Groups perform and compete for the audience's votes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The group that gets the audience fired up the most wins. Pretty simple, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Competitive events are more intense...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But treating one another with respect is very important in this kind of community, so you don't need to stress.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The rules can differ based on the venue too. We can look into details after picking an event to go for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see, they are different from what I've done... But they sound fun too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right? And now there's four of us, it's totally worth giving them a try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your order's ready!
Two coffees and two cafes au lait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great aroma as always.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also brought you some cookies. I'm thinking about adding them to the menu. Please, try them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, they look yummy...!
All for free... Are you really sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, of course.
I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, how's your discussion going? All good?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so.
We're trying to decide which events to be in next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, STAY GOLDEN is coming up. That one's a battle event, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. RUST played at the last one, and everyone went wild when they were on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are they that good?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're top tier! They did RAD WEEKEND together with my dad's group. All of their songs are awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, sounds like you really look up to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess I do. It'd be great to sing at an event featuring them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you know what...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We should enter STAY GOLDEN!
How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The best groups all participate, so it'd be a real trial by fire for us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We could give it a go, and try to turn more heads than RUST did last time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Go big or go home!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Playing as guests at our last event was fun, but it's more satisfying to be competing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all excited about it... But it's going to be a big challenge for me. I have zero experience with this sort of event.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Kohane?
You seem a little tense...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're worried about something, maybe I can offer some advice?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm fine! I was just lost in my thoughts for a moment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Is that so?
I must have misread your expression.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I'm sorry for causing a fuss over nothing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I am honestly a bit anxious, but if my friends are with me... I'm sure it'll work out...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Besides, I've performed in front of an audience many times now. It can't be that much different...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! I'm going to give this event everything I've got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great! You're gonna do fine.
I mean, the audience loved you at our last show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! It's still a little intimidating, but I'll try to sing just like I did then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have more confidence, girl. You're a mind-blowing singer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear how it goes for you. I'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, will do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about we practice today to start work on our event routine? Is everybody okay with going to the park as usual?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome to use the stage at my cafe, if you like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course.
It's all yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO... Thank you so much!
We'll put it to good use!
A few days later
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: STAY GOLDEN's tomorrow! I hope you're pumped up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna do a full rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. I'll count us in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kay! Whenever you're ready, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's go. One, two, three, four!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The four of us sync up so well!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's really got a great voice...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (With this much talent, it makes no sense for her to lack confidence.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe she's afraid of making a mistake because she's inexperienced...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But even if she did slip up, we'd be there to pick her back up and keep going!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We've improved a lot.
I think we're good to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. We've nailed everything down.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really like singing with you guys. I'm having so much fun, it's making my heart race!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't see us not winning STAY GOLDEN!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we can't let our guard down. We can always use more practice!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. We've set our sights not just on winning the event, but also putting on something bigger than RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um... I can't help feeling anxious...
Imagining all the things that could go wrong...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got nothing to worry about, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In the unlikely event that something does go wrong, I'll cover for you and get you back on track, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why are you saying that to her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something wrong, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, forget it... Are you two...? Well, nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An. You can be sure that I'm going to give this show everything I have!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know you will! If you ever get lost, just focus on my voice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Hehe. It's good to know you've got my back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha, of course I do! We're a team!
